newsitem.title: UK: Redland leads building sector rebound.
newsitem.headline: Redland leads building sector rebound.

text.p: Shares in Redland Plc rose on Thursday as the building materials sector recovered from recent weakness, dealers said.
Redland shares gained 7-1/2p to 332-1/2p by 1049 GMT, in volume of over 819,000 shares.
"The sector has been left behind lately and is now looking cheap," said one dealer.
Analysts said the recent strong performances in the bank and pharmaceutical sectors had distracted investors from building materials, leaving it undervalued.

Since the beginning of the year, the building materials sector has underperformed the banking and pharmaceutical sectors by nearly 25 percent and 22 percent respectively, Reuter 3000 analytics showed.
Elsewhere in the sector, RMC Group Plc jumped 14-1/2p to 979p, Meyer International Plc rose 8p to 439p, Blue Circle Industries Plc climbed 8p to 439p and Rugby Group Plc advanced 4-1/2p to 121-1/2p.
